svg.aria-label: Animated diagram on a white background. Flat plates appear one by one across an isometric site grid, then rise into three-dimensional volumes of varying height, resolving into a massing model. Three labelled stages run in sequence: 2D site layout, extruding geometry, 3D Revit model.
svg.title: Automated model generation

svg.text: FROM SITE LAYOUT TO COORDINATED MODEL
